item.title: Whacky, cute, funny. Great!!
item.content:encoded:
This is good. The atmosphere is very consistent with the characters’ personalities. Whacky, funny, makes for a good relaxation for all the disgusting stuff the foundation holds. Not all SCPs are “bad”. They can be cute and funny. It’s a sadness to see them contained. This also makes SCP-2085’s story more powerful as a whole.

Hope more people come to upvote this.

And about the footnote stating the foundation is deliberately hindering scientific development, I personally thinks that’s a inconsistency. Maybe it gives the foundation a villain-like feeling, which is good for this story, but overall it’s over the line of what the Foundation does.
